correct.evidence: All twenty journeys through POST /v1/compute match the fix 6 run in every date, window, item, question and verdict reason. They differ only as point 22b says: null-day stages are unknown, and window-placed job ends are done. Every Timeline row without a petition keeps its dates and items, and cap_gap.for_dso sits only on the grace stages a petition nulled (J12, J13, J14 and J19 twins B to K). One row with too little on it, beyond the SPEC's inputs (finding 1).

sourced.evidence: verify, plain and engine_literals exit 0. The diff adds no rule, number or quote. The row words are the existing DSO line and the point 24a pack words citing 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(vi).

never_assumes.evidence: No gap is read as an answer: missing petition facts are asked and the dates wait null, and the verdict is cannot_tell. But with h1.change_of_status or h1.filed_on missing, J13's grace row gives neither the reason nor the question that would close it.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: The petition's words appear only on grace rows a petition nulled. None of the 20 journeys and 20 petition cases puts them on a transfer or a job report, and none names a petition-changeable stage as now.

secure.evidence: Forty route calls and seven probes, with missing, 'no' and duplicate petition facts, all return 200. The recompute in _step_backs restores the run state, and a mutant without the restore changes no output. No crash or stall found.

tested.evidence: All three fix 7 survivor mutants are killed by test_fix8.py. 8 of 10 Python mutants are caught; the 2 survivors (sb_starts_only, sb_no_restore) change no output on any input I have. 2 of 3 web timeline mutants are caught; the fact lines of an unknown row are not pinned.

findings.title: A grace row nulled by a petition's missing fact shows no reason and no question
findings.input: J13 with h1.change_of_status (or h1.filed_on) left out, POST /v1/compute on 2026-09-29
findings.what_happens: h1.change_of_status is asked, and grace.p1 is unknown with null days, items [] and no reasons (the verdict has no cap_gap.for_dso). The Timeline row shows only the program facts: no dates, no mark, no DSO line and no question. Point 22b says the row keeps its items, including the questions that would close it.

findings.title: Two _step_backs mutants are equivalent on every input I have
findings.input: sb_starts_only (test only the null start) and sb_no_restore (no _restore after the recompute), on the twenty journeys and 20 petition cases
findings.what_happens: Every span a petition nulls loses both days, and the output without the restore is byte for byte HEAD's. No test fails. A future span with one petition-nulled day would need a test.

findings.title: An unknown row's fact lines are not pinned by a web test
findings.input: timeline.ts mutant: row.lines = [] for unknown rows
findings.what_happens: All 575 web tests pass. The known start stays in the meta, which is tested.

findings.title: Cap-gap round: stages with petition-nulled windows carry no step back on their row
findings.input: J19 twin D (pending petition, start 2026-06-09); J14
findings.what_happens: stem.a2 stays current while validations 1 to 3 are null. J14 stem_job_end.w2's final evaluation is null. Neither stage has the reason, so their rows do not say why, as point 22b states. Fix 7 note 1 (twin B, program grace dated from p2's end) and fix 6 note 1 (job-end reports after the card end) are also still open for specs/capgap-1.
